zh-CN.name: Uni Helper
zh-CN.tagline: 增强 uni-app 系列产品的开发体验
zh-CN.description: Uni Helper 是面向 uni-app 的开源工具组织。门户站点汇总创建器、类型、ESLint、UnoCSS 预设等仓库；可安装入口是 create-uni。
zh-CN.audience: 用 uni-app / Vue 做跨端，想把创建、类型和工程配置交给社区工具的团队。
useCases: 用 create-uni 快速创建 uni-app 项目
为 uni-app 和 uni-ui 补齐 TypeScript 类型
接入专为 uni-app 准备的 UnoCSS 预设和 ESLint 配置

faqs.question: Uni Helper 是一个 npm 包还是一个组织？
faqs.answer: 它是 GitHub 组织。本目录用旗舰包 create-uni 作为可安装入口，文档指向组织门户 uni-helper.cn。

faqs.question: 它和 weapp-vite 是同一层吗？
faqs.answer: 不是。weapp-vite 管小程序 Vite 工程；Uni Helper 服务 uni-app 工具体系。两者可以并存，不互相替代。

en.name: Uni Helper
en.tagline: Better DX for the uni-app family
en.description: Uni Helper is an open-source org for uni-app tooling. The portal gathers starters, types, ESLint, and UnoCSS presets; the installable entry is create-uni.
en.audience: Teams building with uni-app / Vue who want community tools for scaffolding, types, and project config.
useCases: Scaffold a uni-app project with create-uni
Add TypeScript types for uni-app and uni-ui
Use the uni-app UnoCSS preset and ESLint config
capabilities: Companion repos including uni-typed, unocss-preset-uni, and eslint-config

faqs.question: Is Uni Helper one npm package or an organization?
faqs.answer: It is a GitHub organization. This catalog uses the flagship create-uni package as the installable entry and points docs at uni-helper.cn.

faqs.question: Is it the same layer as weapp-vite?
faqs.answer: No. weapp-vite owns Vite engineering for mini-programs. Uni Helper serves the uni-app toolchain. They can coexist; neither replaces the other.
